title: More Than 10,000 Pack Polyforum La Fe as Nuevo Laredo Celebrates 178 Years with Bronco
excerpt: More than 10,000 people filled the Polyforum La Fe for Nuevo Laredo's 178th anniversary celebration, an evening of music, food and family time with Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas Villarreal that closed with a performance by Bronco, according to elReporteroMx.
content:
More than 10,000 people packed the Polyforum La Fe for Nuevo Laredo's 178th anniversary celebration, an evening of music, food and family time that brought together residents from every part of the city, according to elReporteroMx.

Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas Villarreal joined the crowd for the celebration, which marked 178 years of the city's history. Families began arriving early in the day and spent the evening singing, dancing and sharing time together, the outlet reported.

The mayor said she was delighted to see so many families gathered together, enjoying themselves and celebrating what they are, and said the turnout showed Nuevo Laredo is going through a great moment as a living, joyful city whose families feel proud of their roots.

Local restaurants set up inside the event to offer typical regional dishes, giving the celebration a taste of local flavor and a showcase for the city's food businesses, according to the report.

The music started at 8 p.m. with Tenssion, a local group that opened the stage and got the crowd dancing. The night's headline moment came with Bronco, whose biggest hits had thousands of voices singing along across generations, turning the Polyforum La Fe into a dance floor, the outlet reported.

The celebration closed as a show of pride in belonging to the city and of residents' enthusiasm for building its future together, according to the report.

Sources: elReporteroMx, Nov. 15, 2026; FM Noticias, Nov. 14, 2026.
